milestones.text: turned up to their first {hobby} session and stayed to the end
milestones.post: Went. Stayed. Didn't run. Counting that.

milestones.text: got through their first warm-up without giggling
milestones.post: Warm-ups are silly. Did them anyway, straight-faced.

milestones.text: spoke loud enough to be heard at the back of the room
milestones.post: Projected! The back row heard me!

milestones.text: learned every name at their first {hobby} meeting
milestones.post: Know all the names now. Belonging, a bit.

milestones.text: stood up in front of the group for the first time
milestones.post: Stood up there. Knees wobbly. Did it.

milestones.text: practised breathing exercises before going on
milestones.post: Breathe in, breathe out, pretend to be calm.

milestones.text: signed up for {hobby} before they could talk themselves out of it
milestones.post: Signed up. Too late to back out now.

milestones.text: survived their first time in front of an audience
milestones.post: First time in front of people. Survived.

milestones.text: performed without needing to look at their notes
milestones.post: No notes needed. It's all in my head.

milestones.text: made the audience laugh on purpose
milestones.post: They laughed where I hoped they would.

milestones.text: got through a whole performance without freezing
milestones.post: No freeze. Just kept going.

milestones.text: came off stage and immediately wanted to go back on
milestones.post: Off stage and already want more.

milestones.text: took a note from the group leader and fixed it by the next session
milestones.post: Took the note. Fixed it. Proud.

milestones.text: stopped shaking before going on
milestones.post: Hands didn't shake tonight. That's new.

milestones.text: kept going smoothly after a small slip
milestones.post: Messed up a bit, kept going, nobody noticed.

milestones.text: became a regular at {hobby}
milestones.post: They know me by name at {hobby} now.

milestones.text: got real applause rather than polite applause
milestones.post: That was the real clapping. Not the polite kind.

milestones.text: had their performance complimented by a complete stranger
milestones.post: A stranger said I was good. Framing it.

milestones.text: took on a bigger part than ever before
milestones.post: Bigger part this time. More to learn, more fun.

milestones.text: found their own stage presence and stopped copying others
milestones.post: Starting to sound like me up there.

milestones.text: rescued a moment when someone else went blank
milestones.post: Covered for a friend. Teamwork.

milestones.text: was trusted to go first and set the tone
milestones.post: Went first tonight. Set the tone. Nailed it.

milestones.text: worked the crowd a little and enjoyed it
milestones.post: Talked to the crowd. They talked back. Fun.

milestones.text: performed in front of their biggest audience yet
milestones.post: Biggest crowd yet. Heart pounding, loved it.

milestones.text: helped a nervous newcomer get through a first time on stage
milestones.post: Helped a newcomer through their first night. Paying it forward.

milestones.text: was asked to perform at a special event
milestones.post: Special event booking. I've been asked!

milestones.text: led the group's warm-up
milestones.post: Led the warm-up. Power is mine.

milestones.text: performed at a neighbouring town's showcase
milestones.post: Out-of-town show. Went over well.

milestones.text: got a mention in the local paper for a performance
milestones.post: Mentioned in the paper. Bought three copies.

milestones.text: drew some of the same faces back for a second night
milestones.post: Repeat audience. They came back for me.

milestones.text: held the room's attention through a long quiet moment
milestones.post: You could hear a pin drop. On purpose.

milestones.text: took part in a contest and made it to the final round
milestones.post: Made the final round. Didn't win. Still thrilled.

milestones.text: won first prize at the regional contest
milestones.post: First prize. Regional. Speechless, ironically.

milestones.text: got a standing ovation
milestones.post: They stood up. All of them. Still floating.

milestones.text: headlined the evening's show
milestones.post: Headliner. My name at the top.

milestones.text: was paid for a performance for the first time
milestones.post: Paid to perform. Professional, technically.

milestones.text: was asked to direct a show of their own
milestones.post: Directing now. Terrifying. Exciting.

milestones.text: performed in the biggest hall in town
milestones.post: The big hall. Full seats. Unreal.

milestones.text: brought a whole audience to tears in a good way
milestones.post: Made a room full of people well up. In a nice way.

milestones.text: was named by a newcomer as the reason for joining
milestones.post: Someone joined because they saw me. Heart full.

milestones.text: had a clip of their performance shared online by a friend
milestones.post: My friend posted a clip. People liked it. Gulp.

milestones.text: rehearsed in front of the mirror and then on their phone camera
milestones.post: Filmed myself rehearsing. Hated it. Learned a lot.

milestones.text: found their place in the alto section and stayed on their part
milestones.post: Stuck to my part. Didn't drift to the tune.

milestones.text: learned the first hymn in the choir's book
milestones.post: First song learned. Many pages to go.

milestones.text: sang a harmony line while the person beside them sang a different one
milestones.post: Held my harmony with someone singing another. Brain!

milestones.text: sang a short solo line in the middle of a choir piece
milestones.post: Four bars of solo. Held the note. Phew.

milestones.text: sang with the choir at the midwinter concert
milestones.post: Midwinter concert. The hall was glowing.

milestones.text: sang the solo in the choir's big seasonal performance
milestones.post: The solo was mine. The whole hall listened.

milestones.text: sang a whole piece in another language without stumbling
milestones.post: Sang it in Latin. Did not trip once.

milestones.text: sang with the choir at the harvest celebration
milestones.post: Harvest songs with the choir. Lovely day.

milestones.text: was made section leader for their voice part
milestones.post: Section leader. I hand out the music now.

milestones.text: learned to follow the conductor's hands instead of the page
milestones.post: Eyes on the conductor. It changes everything.

milestones.text: got cast in their first amateur theatre show, as a crowd member
milestones.post: Cast as Crowd Person Three. Thrilled.

milestones.text: learned their first lines off by heart
milestones.post: Five lines memorised. Character work begins.

milestones.text: made their entrance at exactly the right moment every night
milestones.post: Never missed an entrance. Small brag.

milestones.text: played a speaking role in the season's play
milestones.post: Speaking part! With a name and everything!

milestones.text: played a supporting role that got its own round of applause
milestones.post: Mid-show applause for my scene. Wow.

milestones.text: played the lead in the company's big production
milestones.post: The lead. Still can't believe it.

milestones.text: helped paint the scenery and stayed for the dress rehearsal
milestones.post: Painted trees by day, acted by night.

milestones.text: played a part in the travelling players' show on the green
milestones.post: Acted on the green. A goat watched. Approved.

milestones.text: played the villain in the town hall melodrama and got booed happily
milestones.post: Booed as the villain. Best compliment there is.

milestones.text: got through a whole read-through without losing their place
milestones.post: Read-through done. Never lost the page.

milestones.text: stepped in as an understudy at a day's notice
milestones.post: Understudy to the rescue. One day to learn it.

milestones.text: wrote a short play that the company put on
milestones.post: They staged my play. I sat at the back, beaming.

milestones.text: learned their part in their first barbershop tag
milestones.post: My first tag. Four parts, and mine held.

milestones.text: found out which voice part they sing in the quartet
milestones.post: I'm a baritone, apparently. News to me.

milestones.text: rang their first proper chord with the quartet
milestones.post: We rang a chord. Goosebumps. Literal.

milestones.text: sang a full barbershop song with the quartet in public
milestones.post: Quartet's first song in public. We matched!

milestones.text: sang with the quartet at a local social
milestones.post: Quartet at the social. Straw hats on.

milestones.text: won the barbershop contest with the quartet
milestones.post: Our quartet won! Four very happy voices.

milestones.text: serenaded the bandstand crowd with the quartet on a summer evening
milestones.post: Bandstand singing. Summer evening. Perfect.

milestones.text: held their part steady while the other three tried to pull it off
milestones.post: Held my line against three others. Stubborn.

milestones.text: taught a new tag to a group of beginners
milestones.post: Taught a tag to beginners. They rang it!

milestones.text: was invited to sing with the quartet at the mayor's summer fete
milestones.post: Sang for the mayor. Very fancy. Very nervous.

milestones.text: bought a straw boater for their first quartet rehearsal
milestones.post: Got the hat. Now to learn the singing.

milestones.text: put their name on the open mic list for the first time
milestones.post: My name is on the list. Too late now.

milestones.text: played two songs at their first open mic
milestones.post: Two songs at open mic. Nobody threw anything.

milestones.text: became a regular face at the Thursday open mic
milestones.post: Thursday open mic regular. They save me a seat.

milestones.text: got asked by the host to play an extra song at open mic
milestones.post: Host asked for one more. That's never happened.

milestones.text: was booked for a proper slot after an open mic
milestones.post: Open mic led to a real booking. Excited.

milestones.text: was asked to host the open mic night
milestones.post: Hosting open mic now. The circle completes.

milestones.text: tried out a brand-new song at open mic
milestones.post: Debuted a new song. It survived.

milestones.text: played an original song at open mic for the first time
milestones.post: My own song, out loud, to strangers. Wow.

milestones.text: had their song asked about by name after open mic
milestones.post: Someone asked what my song was called. It has fans.

milestones.text: played a full set as the featured act at open mic
milestones.post: Featured act tonight. Twenty minutes of me.

milestones.text: did their first five minutes of stand-up and got one big laugh
milestones.post: Five minutes. One big laugh. I'll take it.

milestones.text: wrote their first full page of stand-up material
milestones.post: A page of jokes. Some might be funny.

milestones.text: bombed spectacularly at stand-up and went back the next week
milestones.post: Bombed. Came back. That's the job.

milestones.text: got laughs all the way through a full stand-up set
milestones.post: Laughs the whole way. Stand-up high.

milestones.text: was booked as an opener at a comedy club
milestones.post: Opener at a real comedy club. Gulp.

milestones.text: headlined a stand-up night with a full twenty minutes
milestones.post: Twenty minutes headlining. They laughed. A lot.

milestones.text: handled a heckler with a line that got the biggest laugh of the night
milestones.post: Heckler got handled. Crowd loved it.

milestones.text: got a laugh from a joke they had rewritten six times
milestones.post: Draft six of that joke finally landed.

milestones.text: did a tight ten minutes at a showcase
milestones.post: Tight ten at a showcase. Felt sharp.

milestones.text: won a local stand-up competition
milestones.post: Won the comedy competition. Very funny. Ha.

milestones.text: survived their first improv class without freezing
milestones.post: Improv class one. Said yes to everything.

milestones.text: played their first improv game in front of the class
milestones.post: First scene. Was a talking cactus. Committed.

milestones.text: built a whole improv scene with a partner that made the class laugh
milestones.post: Made the whole class laugh. With a partner, sure.

milestones.text: performed in their first improv show
milestones.post: Improv show! No script, no fear. Some fear.

milestones.text: joined a regular improv troupe
milestones.post: I'm in a troupe now. We have a name.

milestones.text: led a long-form improv scene that the audience still talks about
milestones.post: People keep mentioning the scene. Glowing.

milestones.text: kept an improv scene going after their partner went blank
milestones.post: Saved a scene. Yes, and.

milestones.text: stopped planning lines ahead and just listened
milestones.post: Stopped planning. Started listening. Better scenes.

milestones.text: taught a warm-up game to the beginners' class
milestones.post: Taught the beginners a warm-up. They loved it.

milestones.text: performed improv at a comedy festival
milestones.post: Improv at a festival. Big crowd, no script.

milestones.text: sang karaoke for the first time without hiding behind a friend
milestones.post: Sang karaoke solo. Friend stayed at the table.

milestones.text: picked a karaoke song and actually knew the verses
milestones.post: Knew the verses, not just the chorus. Growth.

milestones.text: got the whole room singing along at karaoke
milestones.post: Whole bar sang the chorus with me.

milestones.text: nailed a hard high note at karaoke
milestones.post: Hit the high note. The room gasped.

milestones.text: won the karaoke night's crowd vote
milestones.post: Crowd picked me at karaoke. Small trophy, big grin.

milestones.text: won the city karaoke championship
milestones.post: Karaoke champion. Not joking.

milestones.text: sang a duet at karaoke with a total stranger
milestones.post: Duet with a stranger. Weirdly great.

milestones.text: stopped needing the screen for their go-to karaoke song
milestones.post: Didn't look at the screen once. Showing off.

milestones.text: sang a power ballad that got a cheer before the chorus
milestones.post: They cheered before the chorus even hit.

milestones.text: was asked by the karaoke host to close the night
milestones.post: Asked to close karaoke night. Huge honour.

milestones.text: got through a first rehearsal without hiding at the back
milestones.post: Didn't hide. Progress.

milestones.text: learned a whole part by heart
milestones.post: Whole part, by heart.

milestones.text: stood up in front of the group without shaking
milestones.post: No shaking!

milestones.text: turned up to every rehearsal for a month
milestones.post: Every rehearsal this month.

milestones.text: found a place in the group
milestones.post: I belong here.

milestones.text: learned to project to the back of the hall
milestones.post: Heard at the back!

milestones.text: came off stage wanting to go again
milestones.post: Want to do it again.

milestones.text: was given a few lines of their own
milestones.post: I have lines!

milestones.text: remembered every cue in a long rehearsal
milestones.post: Every cue, caught.

milestones.text: held a long note steady to the end
milestones.post: Held it.

milestones.text: got a laugh in exactly the right place
milestones.post: The laugh came right on time.

milestones.text: stayed calm when a scene went wrong
milestones.post: Recovered on stage. Smooth.

milestones.text: learned to warm up the voice properly
milestones.post: Warm voice, happy voice.

milestones.text: earned a nod from the director
milestones.post: The nod. I got the nod.

milestones.text: was given a bigger part
milestones.post: Bigger part!

milestones.text: performed for a full house
milestones.post: Full house tonight.

milestones.text: carried a scene on their own
milestones.post: Carried the scene.

milestones.text: sang a short solo
milestones.post: Short solo. Big feelings.

milestones.text: helped a nervous newcomer learn a part
milestones.post: Helping a newcomer.

milestones.text: performed at a wedding
milestones.post: Wedding performance.

milestones.text: got a round of applause mid-performance
milestones.post: Applause in the middle!

milestones.text: was given a leading part
milestones.post: Leading part. Terrified. Thrilled.

milestones.text: performed at the biggest venue in town
milestones.post: The big stage.

milestones.text: had a performance talked about all over town
milestones.post: Talk of the town.

milestones.text: was asked to perform at a grand occasion
milestones.post: Performing at a grand occasion.

milestones.text: led the warm-up for the whole company
milestones.post: Led the warm-up.

milestones.text: toured to the next town with the company
milestones.post: On tour! Sort of.

milestones.text: had an encore called for
milestones.post: Encore!

milestones.text: was given the lead in the season's biggest show
milestones.post: The lead. The big one.

milestones.text: brought the house to its feet
milestones.post: Standing ovation.

milestones.text: was asked to coach the newer performers
milestones.post: Coaching now.

milestones.text: performed before honoured guests
milestones.post: Honoured guests in the audience.

milestones.text: became the voice everyone listens for
milestones.post: Everyone listens for my voice now.

milestones.text: was invited to join a well-known company
milestones.post: Invited to a famous company!

milestones.text: gave a performance remembered long after the night
milestones.post: Remembered long after.

sessions.text: Ran through warm-ups before anything else.
Spent a while going over the tricky bit.
Practised in front of the mirror for a while.
Stayed late to chat with the others.
Tried something new and it mostly worked.
Went through the whole thing twice.
Got a useful note from someone more experienced.
Practised breathing to settle the nerves.
Laughed a lot at the others' mistakes, and their own.
Watched the others and picked up a trick or two.
Hummed the parts on the walk home.
Tested a new joke and scribbled notes on it.
Played a few silly games to loosen up.
Picked a new song to try next time.
